subtitle: How cb2026 works, one technique at a time, from an empty board to master strength
description: Every chapter matches a stage of the engine's development and a git tag in the repository (`stage-01-board`, `stage-02-movegen`, ...), so you can check out any stage, run it, change it and measure the result.

Each chapter gives the idea, the real source, how it is tested, what it was worth in Elo, and where to read further. Chapters numbered with a decimal, such as 6.1 or 14.2, came after stage 20, as strength work towards version 1.0.
footnote: Bound from book/src in github.com/cjus/chessengine at commit {commit}. The code excerpts are the source at that commit.
contents_note: Chapters 1 to 21 follow the engine's stages; decimal chapters came later and sit beside the stage they build on.
